title: Privacy Policy
content: At MANAMM, accessible from the MANAMM Mobile Application and manammcare.com, privacy of our visitors and customers is of paramount importance. This document contains information regarding the types of data collected and how it is protected. We collect personal contact details such as name, email, phone number, and delivery address strictly to process e-commerce orders and provide order notifications. We do not sell or trade your personal information to third parties.

title: Terms & Conditions
content: These Terms and Conditions govern your use of the MANAMM application and services. By browsing or purchasing through the application, you agree to comply with these terms. Products offered on MANAMM are subject to stock availability and pricing at the time of purchase. All intellectual property relating to MANAMM products and brand marks belongs exclusively to the company.

title: Refund Policy
content: MANAMM ensures top quality packaging and freshness. If you receive a damaged, expired, or incorrect item, notify us within 48 hours of delivery with photographic evidence. Upon verification, refunds will be initiated to your original payment method within 24 to 48 hours. Depending on your bank or payment provider, funds typically reflect in 3 to 5 business days.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Orders placed on MANAMM are dispatched within 24 to 48 hours from our certified fulfillment centers. Standard delivery across Indian states is completed within 2 to 6 business days. Free shipping is provided for all orders of ₹999 or higher. For orders below ₹999, a flat delivery fee of ₹60 is applied. Tracking numbers are provided as soon as packages are shipped.

title: Cancellation Policy
content: Customers can cancel an order directly from the order details screen at any point prior to shipment dispatch. Once the parcel is marked SHIPPED and handed over to our logistics courier, in-transit cancellation is not supported. For cancelled orders paid via UPI or card, immediate reversal is initiated automatically.
